window: Past 24 hours. Search indexes lagged; two verifiable US local stories surfaced, with no new federal, South America, SOUTHCOM strike or rest-of-world items confirmed.

stories.headline: Montgomery police report a month-long operation netting about $1 million in drugs and six arrests
stories.summary: At a briefing on 29 October, Montgomery, Alabama police said the four-week push recovered 140 lb of marijuana, 5.5 lb of crystal meth, 1.5 lb of fentanyl and 172 g of cocaine.
